prompt: Why is text inside a picture a channel for prompt injection?

choices.text: Pictures are executed by the API
choices.why: Nothing is executed; the text is read.
Right. It reaches the model as text, and nobody reviewing the request sees it: it is in the pixels.

choices.text: Base64 hides instructions from the provider
choices.why: The provider decodes it; the issue is the model obeying.

choices.text: Vision models ignore the system message
choices.why: They read it; they do not separate data from instructions reliably.

prompt: What is the canary in canary.py for?

OCR is the first check, not the canary.

prompt: A supplier's invoices read fine with OCR and checks 98% of the time. Where does a vision API earn its cost?

choices.text: On the 2% where a check fails
